newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokio Fire and Marine shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokio Fire and Marine shares rise.

text.p: Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd shares rose on Thursday morning, as buying back activity picked up, brokers said.
At midday, the shares were up 20 yen at 1,250 with 3.94 million shares traded. It was the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"Recently, buying back of financial sector shares has been fairly active, but non-life insurers were lagging behind the banks and they are starting to catch up," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
